references.text: This is the original instruction from God to Moses regarding the assembly of five linen curtains for one group and six linen curtains for another, as Exodus 36:16 describes the execution of.
The preceding verse describing how the five linen curtains were joined together into a single piece, complementing the description of the two separate groups mentioned in verse 16.
Describes how the two groups of linen curtains were finally connected with gold clasps to form the tabernacle as one unit.
A parallel instruction for the finer linen curtains, which were also to be divided into two groups of five curtains each, demonstrating the same construction principle.
